business_problem: Chime wanted to turn AI into a marketing operating system that could personalize campaigns, accelerate creative work, and improve customer insight without fragmenting teams into disconnected point tools.
solution_summary: Chime embedded ChatGPT and custom GPTs into marketing workflows as part of what its CMO describes as the agentification of marketing. Rather than treating AI as isolated task automation, the team built a horizontal framework that connects content production, performance marketing, lifecycle programs, and customer insight work. AI-assisted storyboarding, video generation, and automated content development reduce agency dependence and increase creative velocity, while PMAX and OfferFit dynamically adjust media spend, messaging, and lifecycle touchpoints using live performance signals. Chime also built Chime Content GPT on top of its best-performing content so AI outputs stay on-brand, and the research team created a custom GPT that acts as an interactive persona database. The program emphasizes top-down sponsorship, iterative rollout, and stronger data inputs so personalization, predictive value bidding, and media optimization improve with use rather than degrade into generic outputs.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Provides the shared AI surface used across marketing, operations, engineering, product, analytics, and more.

solution_components.name: Chime Content GPT
solution_components.role: Generates content aligned to Chime's brand voice by training on the company's best-performing materials.

solution_components.name: PMAX
solution_components.role: Adjusts media spend and campaign decisions in real time based on live performance signals.

solution_components.name: OfferFit
solution_components.role: Optimizes messaging and lifecycle touchpoints as part of Chime's adaptive marketing stack.

solution_components.name: Custom GPT
solution_components.role: Lets researchers query synthetic personas and other internal marketing knowledge in an interactive form.

data_flow: Campaign goals, brand content, customer signals, and performance data flow into Chime's AI framework. Content GPTs and creative tools generate assets, PMAX and OfferFit optimize spend and messaging in market, and research-oriented GPTs turn customer feedback and persona data into insights for product and marketing teams.
business_outcome: Chime created a marketing system that moves from experimentation to real-time optimization, increases content velocity, improves precision in media and lifecycle campaigns, and broadens AI literacy across the organization.
